_doc: Detachment rules the engine applies by itself, keyed by detachment name (Wahapedia spelling).
auto: full = everything in the rule is automatic; partial = the main effect is automatic, the rest is in 'manual'.
units: every entry must match the unit; 'A|B' = either; 'name:X' = datasheet name X; plain words are keywords.
if: all must hold. charged, stationary, within12, targetMV, targetNotMV, targetCharMV, targetOath, belowStarting, belowHalf,
battleShocked, notBattleShocked, inTerrain, onObjective, targetOnObjective, objectiveEitherWay, riled, setUpThisTurn,
offence: hit, wound, ap, strength, attacks (numbers to add), reroll: hits1 | hits | wounds1 | wounds, abilities: weapon abilities.
defend: woundMinusIfStronger, coverUnless12, inv + rangedOnly, enemyStrengthMinus (when this army's unit is attacked).
rolls: rerollAdvance, rerollCharge, advanceSix, advanceBonus, chargeBonus, move (+M), oc (+OC), shockedOc (OC while battle-shocked).
choice: when = command (start of your Command phase, lasts until your next one) | round (each battle round) | battle (start of the battle, lasts all game);
uses = eachOnce (each option once per battle) | limit (at most 'limit' activations, no repeats) | free; pick = options chosen at once.
